physDesc.additional: Script: 'bru tsha. No title on the cover page. Volume letter: Ga Orthography: - Rare use of bindu for m - Palatalization of m (e.g., myi) - Particle pa/ba takes the form pa after final –ng and final -r - Alternative prefix r- for l- (e.g., rkog du gyur) - lasogs pa for la sogs pa - Enclitic particles 'ang, 'am sometimes written as separate syllables

dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo || bcom ldan 'das 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo || bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo ||
ma brtags snang pa dbang po'i gzhu 'dra zhing ||
dpyad na mkha' ltar spros pa rab zhi ba ||
ro gcig nyid du gang gis rtogs gyur pa ||
skyes chen dam pa'i mgon la phyag 'tshal lo ||
mkhas mchog rnams kyis bskal zhing brtag pa'i ||
spros pa rgya chen ring nas gsal mdzad kyang ||
blo chung rnams kyis bden pa gnyis kyi don ||
nges phyir skabs kyi don tsam rnam par dbye |¦|
thub dbang rnams dang 'jam dbyangs dam pa'i mgon ||
rgyal sras klu grub bla ma
skyes chen rnams ||
bdag la rtser dgongs blo'i mun bsal te ||
shes rab snang pas bdag blo brgyan par mdzod ||||

slob dpon ye shes snying pos mdzad pa'i bden pa gnyis rnam par 'byed pa la don lnga ste | mchod par brjod pa dang | rang gi bstan bcos kyi 'bras bu dgos 'brel dang | bden pa gnyis
gtan la dbab pa dang | dbu ma la blo sbyar bar gdams pa dang | bshad pa'i bsod nams yongs su bsngo ba'o ||
dbu ma bden pa gnyis rnam par bshad pa yi ge nyung ngus gzhung gsal bar byed pa | rigs par smra ba'i dge slong chos kyi seng ges sbyar pa || rdzogs s+hO ||
